name: mantle-simulating-evaluating
description: Proves a Mantle agent works using the engine's built-in simulation/evaluation framework: an LLM user-simulator plays the customer per scenario and an LLM judge scores the outcome against natural-language criteria and deterministic assertions. Use when validating an agent end to end, writing eval scenarios, or building a regression suite ("test my agent with simulations", "does it still pass", "evaluate these behaviors").
